Bill.BriefDescription: Helping families suffering financial hardship due to national guard activation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assistance for military families; adding a newsection to chapter 43.330 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that many families ofWashington national guard and military reserves are now, due to aparent being activated and deployed, forced to manage hardships withfewer financial resources. Many families affected by activation anddeployment need help meeting their basic family needs.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.330 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There is established in the department a military family assistanceprogram. To the extent of available funds, the department shallcontract with an existing military family assistance program inWashington state that provides emergency grants to families withfinancial hardship due to national guard activation.
